storeInfo.name: S&P Oyster Co.
storeInfo.tagline: Fresh Mystic Seafood & Waterfront Dining / Mariscos Frescos Frente al Mar

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal, cerca de la barra.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room near the bar.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo y espacio público en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot and public street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato ante cualquier inconveniente.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately with any concerns.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y recogida en el local.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and in-store pickup.

products.descriptionEs: Ostras locales de la costa de Mystic servidas en su concha con hielo picado, mignonette de chalota y limón.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh local oysters served on the half shell with crushed ice, shallot mignonette, and fresh lemon.

products.nameEs: Almejas al Estilo New England (Clams Casino)
products.descriptionEs: Almejas de cuello duro horneadas con tocino crujiente, pimientos, mantequilla de ajo y hierbas finas.
products.descriptionEn: Baked littleneck clams topped with crispy bacon, bell peppers, garlic butter, and fine herbs.

products.descriptionEs: Calamares fritos ligeramente empanizados con rodajas de chiles cherry y acompañados de salsa marinara casera.
products.descriptionEn: Lightly breaded and fried calamari tossed with cherry pepper rings, served with house-made marinara.

products.nameEs: Sopa Cremosa de Almejas (New England Clam Chowder)
products.descriptionEs: Sopa tradicional espesa y cremosa con almejas tiernas, papas y tocino ahumado.
products.descriptionEn: Rich and creamy traditional soup loaded with tender sea clams, diced potatoes, and smoky bacon.

products.descriptionEs: Trocitos de langosta fresca de Maine bañados en mantequilla tibia clarificada, servidos en un pan brioche tostado.
products.descriptionEn: Tender fresh Maine lobster meat tossed in warm drawn butter, served in a toasted split-top brioche roll.
Fresh catch of the day in a crispy beer batter, served with golden fries, coleslaw, and house tartar sauce.
Jumbo sea scallops seared golden brown, served over a creamy parmesan risotto and tender asparagus.
A rich stew of shrimp, mussels, clams, fresh fish, and lobster in a savory spiced tomato broth with garlic crostini.

products.nameEs: Filete de Salmón Glaseado con Arce
products.descriptionEn: Grilled Atlantic salmon filet with a Connecticut maple-mustard glaze, served with mashed potatoes and seasonal vegetables.
Juicy angus beef patty topped with Vermont cheddar, crispy bacon, lettuce, tomato, and house mayo on a brioche bun.
Refreshing house-made natural lemonade infused with fresh New England blueberries.
Draft IPA brewed by local independent craft breweries right here in Connecticut.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con opciones sin gluten en mariscos y opciones vegetarianas. Por favor consulte a su mesero.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer gluten-free seafood preparations and vegetarian items. Please ask your server for details.

faqs.qEn: Do you accept reservations for large groups?
faqs.aEs: Aceptamos reservaciones por teléfono y también contamos con espacio para clientes sin cita previa.
faqs.aEn: We accept phone reservations and also happily accommodate walk-in dining guests.

faqs.aEs: Sí, disponemos de un lote de estacionamiento contiguo al restaurante y áreas de estacionamiento público en la calle.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we have an adjacent parking lot and public street parking spaces available nearby.
